Realtime adaptation (replaces L2 ./useRealtimeEvents + @/lib/sseManager): a module-level singleton reconstructs ONLY the subset useVehicleLive needs — ONE shared EventSource to apiUrl('/events') (= {base}/api/v1/events, matching the web sseManager endpoint /api/v1/events), the `vehicle_update` dispatch, the `connected` lifecycle, auto-connect on first subscriber / auto-disconnect on last unsubscribe, and the capped 1s->60s exponential-backoff reconnect on error (BASE_BACKOFF_MS 1000 / MAX_BACKOFF_MS 60000, failCount-driven, mirroring sseManager.onerror). `connected` mirrors web `state === 'connected'`: false initially ('reconnecting'), true on the server-sent `connected` event, false on error/disconnect. Raw SSE payloads are JSON.parsed WITHOUT camelCaseKeys (so update.vehicle_id/state/signals stay snake_case exactly as web). The internal useVehicleUpdateStream holds the callback in a ref so a changing onVehicleUpdate never re-subscribes (faithful to useRealtimeEvents' callbacksRef + [enabled] deps).

Native-safety & explicit unavailable state (conversion contract rule 7): React Native has no browser EventSource. getEventSourceConstructor() probes globalThis for a host-provided polyfill (the same idiom as api/sseClient / useAchievementUnlocks / useStatusLiveSSE) without importing any DOM module or referencing `window`; a local structural NativeEventSource type keeps the DOM lib out of native output. When no polyfill is present the stream reports the explicit unavailable state — `connected` stays false, no source is opened, nothing throws — and the hook degrades gracefully to the one-shot useVehicleLiveSignals REST hydration. No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, react-i18next, or old web UI components are imported — only `react` and the native parity `../api/client` (apiUrl) + `../api/hooks/useTelemetry`.

Unit handling: this hook is a pure pass-through — parseSignals reads raw signal values straight off the wire and performs NO unit conversion, so the SI cutover contract is unaffected (display-unit conversion stays at the render boundary in consumers). The web field name `chargeRate` sourced from the proto identifier `ChargeRateMilePerHour` is preserved exactly (renaming it would break runtime telemetry plumbing — see the Phase-48 R2 audit-pin note); no new *_mi/*_min/*_mph/*_kwh/*_kw/*_psi-suffixed fields are introduced.
